decisions.reason: The maintenance oil line builds directly on the firm's in-house surface-treatment knowledge and remains the core care offer after the soap and oiled-floor care products were consolidated.
The moisture-protection underlay is a system accessory that the firm's installation guidance can interpret and improve, so it stays in the flooring system range.
The foam underlay sits furthest from the wood-processing core and may be cut if the accessory range is rationalised further, but it is cheap to keep as a standard partner-sourced component.
The oak parquet line is at the centre of the firm's wood-processing expertise and production base, which gives it the strongest ability to learn from results and develop the line further.
